title: City transit budget expansion
overview: After months of negotiation the city council approved a new transit budget that commits 45 million dollars to bus rapid transit. [1][2] The transit expansion approved this week represents the largest single investment in public transportation the city has made in a decade. [3] Advocates said the expansion will cut average commute times across the northern corridor. [1]

key_findings.text: After months of negotiation the city council approved a new transit budget that commits 45 million dollars to bus rapid transit.

children.text: The city council approved a new transit budget on Tuesday evening after a lengthy public hearing.

key_findings.text: The transit expansion approved this week represents the largest single investment in public transportation the city has made in a decade.
Advocates said the expansion will cut average commute times across the northern corridor.
Transit officials confirmed construction would begin in early 2027 pending environmental review.
The bus rapid transit lines are expected to serve an additional forty thousand riders daily once complete.
